events.name: start
events.summary: Runs during preparation; game-dependent operations are unavailable.

events.name: stop
events.summary: Final callback before registrations are removed.

events.name: world_ready
events.summary: A world becomes ready, including activation into an existing world.

events.name: world_leave
events.summary: The world is leaving; old handles expire.

events.name: saved
events.summary: The original game save is confirmed and associated metadata is committed.

events.name: update
events.summary: One game update with delta seconds.

events.name: render
events.summary: Draw UI widgets during this render callback.

events.name: input
events.summary: Owned hotkey event, suspended while the Mods menu is open.

events.name: object_changed
events.summary: A supported original native placement, move or removal was observed.

events.name: action_completed
events.summary: A queued world action has a terminal status; unknown is not success.
